Former minister and Deputy Leader of the BRS Legislature Party, T. Harish Rao, alleged that the Congress government is not providing even eight hours of uninterrupted power supply for agricultural needs. The Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) commissioner, also the district election officer for Hyderabad, and all district collectors have been instructed to conduct special camps for voter enrollment. Applications received through Form-6 will be processed for inclusion in the final electoral roll, which is scheduled to be published on November 9.

The model code of conduct has come into immediate effect. The last date for filing nominations for urban local body elections is October 18, and candidates can withdraw their papers until October 21. Vote counting for these elections will occur on October 30. Elections to Mandal Parishad Territorial Constituencies (MPTCs) and Zilla Parishad Territorial Constituencies (ZPTCs) will take place on November 3, with counting on November 5. Gram panchayat elections are scheduled in three phases on November 26, November 29, and December 2, with votes counted on the respective polling days. Andhra Pradesh is expected to experience a wet spell from October 14 to 19, with the Northeast Monsoon setting in over South Peninsular India from October 15. Light to moderate and isolated heavy rainfall are likely across the state from October 16 to 19. President Droupadi Murmu is scheduled to inaugurate the National Saras Mela 2026 in Vijayawada today at Punnami Ghat on the banks of the Krishna River. This is the first time the national-level event, showcasing products from rural women entrepreneurs, is being held outside the Delhi-National Capital Region. The YSRCP has accused the coalition government of misusing official machinery and obstructing its candidates in the upcoming local body elections, citing delays and incorrect caste details on certificates for their candidates. They also alleged police intimidation of YSRCP aspirants and cadre. Revenue authorities have been directed to issue caste certificates to aspiring candidates within 24 hours to prevent delays in election participation.
